name: AI agent
author: Notia
description: A chat agent beside your notes, with continuations in the editor.

name: Daily notes
author: Notia
description: Opens a note for each day, creating it when needed. Its folder and name are in its settings.

name: Markdown editor
author: Notia
description: Inserts headings, emphasis, lists, links, images, tables, quotes, and callouts at the cursor.

name: Templater
author: Notia
description: Creates a note from a template, or inserts one at the cursor, in a single command.

name: Theme enhancer
author: Notia
description: Folder icon packs, icon colors, and a CSS file that overrides the active theme.

name: Calendar
author: Notia
description: A month calendar in the right sidebar. Selecting a day lists notes whose path contains that date.

name: Image Editor
author: Notia
description: Crop and resize images embedded in notes (png/jpeg/webp). Uses the edit library; pair with the native companion for in-app edits.

name: Table Enhancer
author: Notia
description: Insert and edit Markdown tables from a toolbar above the note.
